title: Reset a forgotten user password
text: Verify the user by callback to the number on file. Reset the password in the admin console, force a change at next sign-in and confirm multi-factor authentication still works.

title: VPN will not connect
text: Check the user's internet access first, then confirm the VPN client version. Restart the VPN client, clear the saved profile and re-import the profile. If it still fails, check the VPN gateway status page.

title: Linux server disk almost full
text: Run df -h to find the full filesystem, then du -sh on the top directories. Rotate or compress old logs, clear package caches and never delete database files. Escalate if usage stays above 90 percent.

title: TLS certificate about to expire
text: List certificates expiring within 30 days. Renew through the certificate authority portal, deploy the new certificate to the load balancer and verify the new expiry date in a browser.

title: Quarterly backup restore test
text: Restore the latest backup into an isolated test host. Compare file counts and a sample of checksums, record the restore time and file any mismatch as an incident.

title: Onboard a new laptop
text: Enrol the device in management, apply the baseline configuration, enable disk encryption and install the standard software. Hand over with a checklist signed by the user.

title: Printer shows offline
text: Check power and network cable, print a test page from the printer panel, then remove and re-add the printer queue on the affected computer.

title: Monthly patch window
text: Patch on the second Tuesday of each month after a snapshot. Apply updates to a pilot group first, wait two days, then roll out to everyone and keep the snapshot for one week.

title: Acme project room access
text: Acme project room access is granted by the Acme engagement manager. Raise a ticket tagged ACME-ROOM and attach the manager's written approval before adding anyone to the room group.

title: Acme data export handling
text: Acme data exports must be encrypted and shared only through the Acme secure folder. Delete local copies after upload and log the deletion in the Acme ticket.

title: Globex negotiation workspace access
text: Globex negotiation workspace access needs approval from the Globex engagement lead. Raise a ticket tagged GLOBEX-WORKSPACE and keep the approval in the ticket.

title: Globex pricing model files
text: Globex pricing model files stay in the Globex restricted share. Never email them, and review the share permissions every month.
